science.qualification: Photosphere color from a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The disc is unresolved: no map or absolute brightness is implied. Self-luminous, so no lighting. The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret et al. (2020), A&A 634, A93 compute from pure-hydrogen (DA) white-dwarf model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 25,369 K and log g 8.63 (u1 0.087, u2 0.267): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used; its atmosphere is DA: Bond et al. (2017), ApJ 840, 70, section 8: the STIS spectra show only the Balmer lines, confirming a DA2 white dwarf with a pure hydrogen atmosphere (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-4357/aa6af8).

offLimbContext.source: none: no observation, a transparent plate

limbMaterial.composition: black alpha darkens the photosphere according to the selected limb-darkening law; transparent outside the silhouette
